name: io.github.MagicSquarekey/hybrid-recursive-ladder
title: Hybrid Recursive Ladder
description: Aggregate long time-series ranges with a few source requests instead of one per bucket.

environmentVariables.name: HL_SOURCE
environmentVariables.description: Source backend: demo (default), thingsboard, or postgres.

environmentVariables.name: HL_TB_URL
environmentVariables.description: ThingsBoard base URL, for example http://localhost:9090.

environmentVariables.name: HL_TB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: ThingsBoard access token, used instead of username and password.

environmentVariables.name: HL_PG_DSN
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL DSN for the local materialized store.

environmentVariables.name: HL_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone for calendar boundaries; default Asia/Shanghai.

environmentVariables.name: HL_FINEST
environmentVariables.description: Finest ladder level: minute, hour, day, or month.
